scope: Twenty paired source-grounded research-intent diagnostics for the reviewed Canadian DFHD historic-place supplement. Not blind benchmarks, relevance annotations, lifecycle evidence or an inventory of every Canadian cultural place. Government province fields describe the source association; representative points do not establish legal or archaeological boundaries.
